# Reptilians
## General Information
Reptilians can [color=lightgreen]use their tail to drag objects around[/color], keeping both their hands free.
Their sharp claws make their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage.
The reptilian digestive system [color=palevioletred]can only process fruits and meat[/color], but can [color=lightgreen]digest raw meat and blood[/color] without ill effects. They are [color=palevioletred]poisoned[/color] by allicin (found in garlic and onions) and theobromine (found in caffeinated beverages and chocolate).
They take [color=palevioletred]30% more Cold damage.[/color] They prefer a somwehat warmer temperature range than humans.
